Why Seagrass

Most of the ocean is unmonitored. We're fixing that.

Coastlines, reefs, and waterways are surveyed intermittently expensive vessels, limited availability, human risk. Seagrass deploys autonomous surface vehicles that operate continuously, navigate dynamically, and stream data back in real time.

From marine conservation to infrastructure inspection, our platform turns any body of water into a persistently observable environment.

Built at · Founders Inc. Off Season II · Fort Mason, San Francisco · June – August 2026
Backed & supported by

Under the hull

Full-stack autonomy, built from the water up

Autonomous Navigation

MAVLink-based mission planning with real-time waypoint routing, obstacle awareness, and dynamic mode switching running on ArduSub atop a Pixhawk flight controller.

pymavlinkArduSubMAVLink

Perception & Vision

YOLOv8 Nano running onboard for real-time object detection identifying vessels, buoys, and marine life at low power, low latency, entirely edge-side.

YOLOv8OpenCVnumpy

BlueOS Integration

The full autonomy stack ships as a BlueOS Docker Extension on Raspberry Pi plug-and-play deployment with a clean REST interface for all sensor and mission data.

BlueOSDockerRaspberry Pi
